text: /* @component: .gallery-section */(function () { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-section'); sections.forEach(section => { const btns = section.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn'); const items = section.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item'); btns.forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const filter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter'); btns.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn)); items.forEach(item => { item.style.display = 'none'; }); items.forEach(item => { setTimeout(() => { const category = item.getAttribute('data-category'); const isVisible = filter === 'all' || category === filter; if (isVisible) { item.style.display = 'block'; item.classList.add('visible'); } }, 1); }); }); }); }) })})();/* @component: .gallery-section */
